title: Batch macOS jobs run on the owner's MacBook; drafts skip macOS while a batch runs
why: Owner 14:19 CST Nov 12 (R58, plan 0a36899): "agreed on e, my mac isn't available all the time but imjust saying it shd be available rn and it can help". OWNER CALLS ON #3409 12:00 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 11:44, relayed; the lane's own list is unread by triage): #3409 (replaces #2970, batch macOS jobs on the owner's Mac) lists three owner calls: (1) move batch-macos-skip.py out of PR code, or accept that github.token and RUNNER_TOKEN reach PR-head scripts; (2) the MAC_RUNNER_READ_TOKEN secret and the Mac runner registration; (3) fork-PR approval and runner scope. The coordinator rules none; the PR stays draft. Call 1 is posted as item 838. Calls 2 and 3 are not posted: item 649 closed 21:11 CST Nov 12 with the runner online and the token set (store entry mac-runner-token-scope), and R58 says never a fork PR; triage asked the coordinator what #3409 needs that is new. #2970 closed as replaced by #3409.
source: owner 14:19 CST Nov 12, via retrospective 14:20 CST
note: R55 express. Home: decision no-merge-during-batch-ci. Runner label claude-settings-mac; GitHub macOS fallback when offline; never a fork PR; a draft's macOS job skips while a batch run is in progress (page items 639 a, 640 a). Lane started 14:21 CST by the coordinator. From ci-split-checks-family 14:44 CST Nov 12: once batch macOS jobs run on the MacBook, a 4th macOS guard job (about 15.7 min each, projected) no longer queues against GitHub's macOS limit; reopen the split then. Lane 15:10 CST Nov 12: #2970 handed to runner 10 as express (R55). Owner acts open, page item 649: register the claude-settings-mac runner, add repo secret MAC_RUNNER_READ_TOKEN (Administration: Read). Until both, batch runs use macos-latest. Unmeasured: one runner process runs the three macOS jobs one after another. Item 649 v2 15:15 CST Nov 12: the degen repo's token serves if its repo access includes claude-settings with Administration: Read (owner asked 15:13 CST; coordinator answered). Owner 15:15 CST Nov 12 on item 649: "gotcha ill set it up but in a couple hours so till then keep as you have been". He registers a second runner on the same MacBook for claude-settings (a repo-level runner on a personal account serves one repo); batches stay on macos-latest until then. Item 649 stays open. Owner 21:09 CST Nov 12 (retro relay 21:10): token has Administration: read and stays on all shivinate7 repos (store entry mac-runner-token-scope); runner claude-settings-mac online. Item 649 closed 21:11 CST. Lane 21:09: #2970 warns loudly on any non-200 runner-list read.
